_howto: Real-brand test: Nicobar Retro collection, real SKUs (see refs/product/SKUS.md). campaign.md was written by the fashion-campaign-director skill via /campaign.
brief: Brand: Nicobar (India), Retro collection, Nov 2026. Brand line: "Retro, with a restless streak. Punchy colours, feel-good layers and a little nostalgia for places you've never been. Made for a winter of wander." Real SKUs, must be shown exactly as the reference photos (refs/product/): LOOK A — Swing Sweater NBI053577 (boxy cap-sleeve cotton knit, brown ground, large periwinkle flowers with oatmeal centres, navy-and-brown two-tone rib, small heart coin at chest; brand styles it over a long white shirt) + Spark Skirt NBI053583 (fitted brown cotton-knit pencil midi below the knee, back slit, thin periwinkle stripe at hem) + Poppy Hour Scarf NBI054589 (long cotton-knit scarf, chartreuse ground, large periwinkle poppies, buttons at corners). LOOK B — Fir Sweater NBI053543 (oversized berry cotton-knit crewneck, periwinkle neck rib, periwinkle-and-white leopard stretching across the front) + Kindle Pants NBI055015 (dark navy denim with tonal lighter pinstripes, high rise, bootcut flare) + Yin-Yang Beanie NBI054549 (half berry, half chartreuse, red heart charm). Non-SKU basics allowed only as the brand styles them: long white cotton shirt, cream chelsea boots, white sneakers, striped socks. Location: Ghum station and the Batasia Loop on the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, early winter morning, mist lifting, the blue steam toy train. Models: a Darjeeling-born woman in her late 20s, petite, long straight black hair, wind-flushed cheeks; and a woman in her mid-30s, tall, deep brown skin, short natural curls. Vibe: the brand's own — retro, restless, a winter of wander, nostalgia for a place you've never been.
